interactions.summary: A student keeps pushing the harmonized-will model toward godhood through power, and Jiang rejects that move by restating Dante's aim as harmony with God rather than becoming God.

The room asks how absolute and contingent will can be joined, one student answers that fear of death shrinks when the unknown becomes known, and Jiang answers with two historical paths: gnosis and love.
A student reads Dante's passage about the mind resting only in truth and doubt blossoming upward from truth into further questions.

claims.claim: Jiang says Dante's framework does not seek divinization through power; it distinguishes the absolute will that stays connected to God from the contingent will that acts within worldly choice, and it aims to harmonize them so a person moves closer to God.
Jiang diagnoses Piccarda's failure as a split in which her absolute will remained loyal to God while her contingent will surrendered to fear.

Jiang presents two historical ways of overcoming the fear that splits the will: knowledge or gnosis, which removes fear by revealing death as passage rather than nothingness, and love, which unifies action because all choice becomes ruled by devotion.
In Jiang's reading, unconditional love can combine absolute and contingent will because it makes concrete action answer to a single higher devotion.

signature_moments.moment: Jiang gives the room a stark pair of remedies for fear: either know enough about the universe that death stops looking like annihilation, or love someone so totally that fear falls away.
signature_moments.source_phrase: knowledge is one possibility. But another possibility is the idea of love
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It compresses Jiang's practical answer to divided will into two memorable spiritual technologies.

signature_moments.moment: The Dante passage frames doubt not as failure but as a shoot growing out of truth and driving the mind upward.
signature_moments.source_phrase: our doubting blossoms like a shoot out from the root of truth
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It underwrites Jiang's defense of questioning as the path to understanding.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Jiang's first historical solution to fear: knowledge of the universe that dissolves dread of death.
Bringing absolute will and contingent will into alignment so action moves a person closer to God.

chronology_notes.note: This June 15 packet moves from Jiang's anti-godhood correction into his first explicit remedies for divided will, then immediately anchors questioning itself in Dante's image of doubt growing from truth.
